notes.title: The spin-off game of CREEP ZONE is now available!
notes.content:
[h3] “Mandragora Seeker in the CREEP ZONE” Released on January 23! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079650/b61d8c2c8fa1f852143dd3228c693be7aede556c.png[/img]

[h3] 👤 Meet the Timid Gravekeeper, Our New Protagonist [/h3]
This time, a resident of the unique world of “CREEP ZONE” takes the spotlight.
Discover how this new adventure from the perspective of a resident ties into the main story—don’t miss it!

[h3] 🌱 Story Highlights [/h3]
• Follow the protagonist as they venture into mandrake gathering and meet a mysterious girl, kicking off a fascinating tale.
• Get a glimpse of the enigmatic world of “CREEP ZONE”!
• You might uncover unexpected sides of the residents you thought you knew!

[h3] ⏰ Limited-Time Discount! [/h3]
To celebrate the release, enjoy a 30% OFF sale from January 23 to February 2!
Don’t miss this chance to dive into the thrilling new adventure of this spin-off game!



[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3427650/Mandragora_Seeker_in_the_CREEP_ZONE/][h3]🔗 Check out the game page here![/h3][/url]
